notes: three branches (Yahya, Abu Kurayb, Ibn Numayr) each name their own shaykh, then «جميعا عن هشام بن عروة» converges them: the names after it are the shared tail
«حدثنا أبي» (Ibn Numayr's father) is named only by relation
«لم يذكر ابن نمير فقد» is a wording difference: left out
«- واتفقوا في اللفظ -» is an editor's gloss
